query: Is the proposed airworthiness directive under docket FAA-2012-0495, covering Gulfstream Galaxy and Gulfstream 200 brake wear indicating pins, still active, or has the FAA withdrawn it?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. The FAA published an NPRM on 2012-05-18 proposing to require checking and, where needed, shortening the brake wear indicating pins on certain Gulfstream Galaxy and Gulfstream 200 airplanes. On 2012-10-14 the FAA withdrew that NPRM, so the proposed AD will not be adopted under this docket and there is no open comment deadline.

query: What is the current status of the FAA's proposed airworthiness directive under docket 2003-NM-66-AD for EMBRAER EMB-145 series airplanes (the IC-600 integrated computer strap modification to disable CAT II operations with the flight director)? Is it still open for comment or was it withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. The NPRM issued 2004-01-16 proposed modifying the strap configuration of IC-600 1 and 2 integrated computers to disable CAT II operations with the flight director. It was formally withdrawn by a later notice issued 2004-09-16, so no final rule is pending from this docket and there is no open comment deadline.

query: Is the proposed AD under docket FAA-2007-0242 on clevis pin replacement for GE CF6-80C2 and CF6-80E1 engine thrust reversers still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: It is no longer active. The FAA issued the NPRM on 2008-02-15, proposing replacement of clevis pins on the thrust reverser central drive units and actuators (or replacement of pins that fail an on-wing rebound hardness test). On 2008-10-01 the FAA published a notice withdrawing that NPRM, so the proposal is withdrawn and there is no open comment period.

query: For docket FAA-2017-0812, the proposed AD on fuselage structure reinforcement for Airbus A330-200, A330-200 Freighter, and A330-300 airplanes because of widespread fatigue damage, is it still open for comment or has it been changed or withdrawn?
gold_status: The proposal is no longer active. The NPRM issued 2017-09-07 (doc 2017-19760) was withdrawn by the FAA in a notice issued 2019-05-03 (doc 2019-09742). The FAA determined, after the NPRM was issued, that the proposed AD was not needed, so no final rule will result from it and there is no open comment deadline. The withdrawal notice is the latest entry.

query: Is the FAA's proposal under docket FAA-2015-3657 to supersede AD 2007-25-08 for the Eurocopter SA-365/AS-365/SA-366/EC155 helicopters still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: No longer active. The NPRM was published 2015-08-21 (doc 2015-21689) proposing to supersede AD 2007-25-08. On 2016-11-02 the FAA withdrew it (doc 2016-27639), so the proposal is dead and AD 2007-25-08 stays in effect. There is no open comment deadline.

query: Is the proposed airworthiness directive under docket FAA-2016-6417 for Boeing DC-10, MD-10 and MD-11 airplanes (the fuel system NPRM) still active, or has it been withdrawn?
gold_status: No longer active. The FAA withdrew the NPRM in a notice issued 2017-08-02 (doc 2017-16775). The original proposal (doc 2016-10735, issued 2016-04-27 and published May 10, 2016) was withdrawn because the FAA determined that the identified unsafe condition is adequately addressed by existing actions.
